articles.text: Many ex-aides to Harris betting against a 2028 run Many of those who knowKamala Harrisbest think she ultimately won't run for the White House in 2028.Why it matters:What the former vice president decides to do is one of the biggest X factors in the next presidential contest: Early pollssuggestHarris is the frontrunner to be the Democratic nominee, and if she opted out, it would scramble the primary.Zoom in:Over the past year, a surprisingly large number of former aides, surrogates and donors to Harris have told Axios they believe she won't launch another campaign.They argue that the moves she's making — hitting the trail for midterm candidates, going on the podcast circuit, and writing a book — might make her look like a contender-in-waiting, but actually amount to her simply trying to maintain influence.Harris has said publicly and privately she hasn't made up her mind yet, and some of her former aides concede they could be wrong — or could even be"wishcasting"because they don't want her to pursue another bid.This week, we surveyed...
